items.raw_excerpt: 28-year-old Valerio Tuveri became known on social media as "the guy who cleans Rome" after he began posting videos of himself cleaning graffiti from the Italian capital's walls.
items.summary_en: 28-year-old Valerio Tuveri became known on social media as 'the guy who cleans Rome'. He posts videos of himself cleaning graffiti from the Italian capital's walls.

items.raw_excerpt: The mayor of Upper Hutt is already eyeing the marked-for-closure Trentham race course for high density housing.
items.summary_en: The mayor of Upper Hutt wants to turn the Trentham race course into high-density housing. The race course is set to close. The plan could create more homes in the area.

items.title_en: Upper Hutt mayor proposes homes on closing race course

items.raw_excerpt: El evento de música latina se realizará el 24 y 25 de octubre en el Parque O'Higgins.
items.summary_en: The Latin music festival announced its full schedule and artist order. The event will take place on October 24-25 at Parque O'Higgins in Santiago.

items.title_en: Bamba Festival releases schedule and artist lineup

items.raw_excerpt: PHOZI VILLAGE, South Africa — On a grassy mountainside overlooking the Indian Ocean on South Africa’s Eastern Cape coast, dozens of cattle graze freely. For generations, families in the small rural villages of Tyolomnqa, Phozi, and Qaga, about 30 miles from the nearest city, KuGompo, have relied on these communal lands for food, income, healing […]
items.summary_en: Rural villages on South Africa's Eastern Cape coast rely on communal lands for cattle grazing. A mining company wants to dig for heavy sands there. Community members say the mine will destroy their way of life.
items.summary_ko: 남아프리카공화국 이스턴케이프 해안의 작은 시골 마을 주민들은 공동 목초지에서 소를 키우며 살아왔다. 채광 회사가 그 땅에서 중광물을 캐겠다고 나서면서 마을 사람들의 생계가 위협받고 있다. 주민들은 광산이 삶의 터전을 완전히 바꿔놓을 것이라고 말한다.
items.title_en: South African villages fight a mining project that destroys their grazing lands
items.title_ko: 남아공 시골 마을들, 공동 목초지를 파괴할 광산에 맞서 싸우다
items.title_original: ‘The shape of the land will change:’ South African villages resist heavy sands mine - news - Mongabay

items.raw_excerpt: Concerns rise as the Pampa River's receding water threatens the traditional Aranmula boat race and upcoming water festival.
items.summary_en: The Pampa River's water level is dropping, threatening the traditional Aranmula boat race in Kerala. The upcoming water festival may also be affected. Local communities are worried about losing this cherished tradition.
items.summary_ko: 케랄라 주 팜파강의 수위가 낮아지면서 유서 깊은 아란물라 전통 보트 경주가 위협받고 있습니다. 다가오는 물 축제도 영향을 받을 수 있어 지역 주민들의 우려가 커지고 있습니다.
items.title_en: The Aranmula boat race faces uncertainty as the Pampa River runs shallow
items.title_ko: 팜파강 수위 낮아져 아란물라 전통 보트 경주 위기
items.title_original: As Pampa runs shallow, cherished tradition of Aranmula faces uncertain days

items.raw_excerpt: A dinosaur fossil discovered on Portugal's west coast could become one of the country's most important palaeontological finds to date, with researchers describing it as the most complete dinosaur skeleton ever uncovered in Portugal.
items.summary_en: A dinosaur fossil discovered on Portugal's west coast could become one of the country's most important palaeontological finds. Researchers say it is the most complete dinosaur skeleton ever uncovered in Portugal.
items.summary_ko: 포르투갈 서해안에서 발견된 공룡 화석이 이 나라에서 가장 중요한 고생물학적 발견 중 하나가 될 전망이다. 연구자들은 이 화석이 포르투갈에서 발굴된 것 중 가장 완전한 공룡 뼈대라고 말한다.
items.title_en: Most complete dinosaur fossil found in Portugal

items.raw_excerpt: Lucas Legare has been going to the site of the bridge with his grandparents since he was two years old.
items.summary_en: Lucas Legare has been visiting the Gordie Howe International Bridge site with his grandparents since he was two. Now nine years old, he has watched the bridge slowly rise over seven years. The bridge connects Windsor, Ontario to Detroit, Michigan.
items.summary_ko: 루카스 레가르는 두 살 때부터 조부모님과 함께 고디 하우 국제 대교 건설 현장을 찾아왔다. 올해 아홉 살이 된 그는 7년 동안 자신의 집 앞에서 다리가 세워지는 모습을 지켜봤다. 이 다리는 온타리오주 윈저와 미시간주 디트로이트를 연결한다.
items.title_en: Boy watches Gordie Howe bridge rise over seven years
items.title_ko: 고디 하우 다리와 함께 자란 아홉 살 소년
items.title_original: He didn’t just watch the Gordie Howe bridge rise — he kind of grew up beside it

items.raw_excerpt: Los menores de siete años podrán ingresar gratis, mientras que los niños de ocho a 12 años tendrán un descuento del 50 por ciento.
items.summary_en: Children under 7 can enter free, and children aged 8 to 12 get a 50 percent discount. The benefit applies for the rest of the season.

items.raw_excerpt: Tim Hortons has announced a new Harry Potter promotion, but the reaction online has been anything but magical.
items.summary_en: Tim Hortons launched a new Harry Potter-themed promotion. Critics say it is un-Canadian and anti-trans because of J.K. Rowling's views. Online reaction has been very negative.

items.raw_excerpt: Queenstown's mayor says the government's fast-track process is allowing developers to sidestep years of planning work, leaving councils and communities to pick up the bill.
items.summary_en: People in Arrowtown, New Zealand are protesting a new housing development. They say the government's fast-track process lets builders skip important planning steps. Local leaders say communities end up paying the cost.
items.summary_ko: 뉴질랜드 애로우타운 주민들이 새 주택 개발 계획에 항의하고 있다. 주민들은 정부의 패스트트랙 절차가 건설사들이 중요한 계획 단계를 건너뛰게 한다고 말한다. 지역 지도자는 궁극적으로 지역사회가 비용을 부담하게 될 것이라고 지적한다.
items.title_en: Arrowtown residents protest fast-track housing plan
items.title_ko: 애로우타운 주민들, 패스트트랙 주택 개발 반대 집회
items.title_original: Arrowtown residents rally against proposed fast-track housing development

items.raw_excerpt: "Por el nivel de nieve -que son cinco metros en nuestro sector y en el lado argentino-, va a ser imposible", dijo la Delegación Presidencial de Valparaíso. El paso fronterizo se encuentra inoperativo desde el 14 de julio, pese a los esfuerzos del Ejército y de Vialidad para despejar las vías.
items.summary_en: Heavy snow has trapped 1,700 trucks at the Los Libertadores border crossing between Chile and Argentina. The government says the pass will not reopen for at least 10 days. The crossing has been closed since July 14.
items.summary_ko: 폭설로 인해 칠레와 아르헨티나를 잇는 로스 리베르타도레스 고개에서 트럭 1,700대가 발이 묶였습니다. 칠레 정부는 최소 10일 이상 국경 통로를 재개하지 않겠다고 밝혔습니다. 이 고개는 7월 14일부터 폐쇄된 상태입니다.
items.title_en: 1,700 trucks stranded as Chile rules out reopening Los Libertadores pass for 10 days
items.title_ko: 칠레-아르헨티나 국경 고개 1,700대 트럭 발묶여, 10일 이상 통제
items.title_original: Varados 1.700 camiones y contando: Gobierno descarta reabrir Los Libertadores antes de 10 días
